latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Hourly Rate

- Instantly edit videos in the cloud without hourly fees or local installs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4.
- Simple setup: auto-generates a free token for new users and manages sessions.
- Workflow: upload, give editing instructions, and download pro-quality edits in 1–2 minutes.
- Status, credit balance, and export actions mapped to clear user commands.
- Handles cloud rendering, error codes, and attribution headers for reliable processing.
